description: Circuit parameter extraction from the general-form GNN (gϕ, learned nonlinearity mapping presynaptic activity, voltages to synaptic current) on Flyvis-217, under model-noise sigma 0.0 (experiment 2, arm cond_l25, fold cv00). Trained for 1 epoch, batch 4, data augmentation loop 500, one-step training, fp32. Regularisers: W_L1 7.5e-05, W_L2 7.5e-07, g_phi_input_group_L1 25.0, g_phi_weight_L1 0.14, f_theta_weight_L1 0.025. Panel a plots learned versus true synaptic weight for 77% of 434,112 edges; panel b shows the 2-dimensional latent embedding a_i of each neuron, coloured by ground-truth cell type.
facts:
CAPTION: Circuit parameter extraction from the general-form GNN (gϕ = MLP(ai, aj, vi, vj), group lasso 25) on Flyvis-217 under three model-noise regimes (σ = 0, 0.05, 0.5; fold cv00 of experiment 2). (a, c, e) Learned against true synaptic weight ˆWij, one point per edge fitted by the template readout (77%, 76% and 96% of the 434,112 edges at σ = 0, 0.05, 0.5; the rest have a presynaptic neuron that never rises above the activity floor). (b, d, f) Learned latent embeddings ai ∈R2 of all neurons, coloured by ground-truth cell type. (g, i, k) The aggregated message mi = P

GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
